prompt.generated_prompt_string: A photorealistic 4:5 vertical commercial-style image of a fit adult woman with a deep bronzed sun-kissed tan and glistening wet-look skin, reclining diagonally on white Mediterranean-style stucco stairs with a Santorini or Mykonos atmosphere. She has a toned slim-muscular body and wears the exact vibrant royal-blue triangle bikini with high-cut minimalist bottoms shown in the reference. Her dark brown-black hair is slicked back in a wet look away from her face. She is relaxed and confident: legs extended diagonally and crossed at the ankles, right arm bent holding an approved energy-drink can to her lips as she drinks, left arm bent with her hand behind her head or neck. Her face is in profile to three-quarter view, head slightly tilted back, minimal natural makeup. There are seven approved cans total: one in her hand, two on the step behind her left shoulder, one under her right thigh, two near her calves and one on the bottom step near her feet. The white plaster wall has the approved brand relief embossed twice in stacked white-on-white texture. Use stark white and deep cobalt geometric accents behind the stairs. Lighting is harsh midday sunlight with crisp diagonal shadows and high contrast between bright whites and deep blues, creating a summer, refreshing, energetic and luxurious mood. Shot like a high-end advertising campaign with diagonal composition, sharp focus on model and product, deep depth of field, 8K and hyper-detailed rendering.
